source_chart_summary: Figure 1 is a 100% stacked vertical bar chart titled 'Companies plan to offer more benefits in five years.' answering 'QUESTION: In five years, do you think your company will be offering fewer, the same or more benefits than it does now?'. It shows three employer size categories: Small (10–99 employees) with 3% Fewer benefits, 40% About the same, 57% More benefits (+7% change from 2023); Midsize (100–999 employees) with 1% Fewer benefits, 35% About the same, 64% More benefits (+6% change from 2023); and Large (1,000 or more employees) with 3% Fewer benefits, 30% About the same, 67% More benefits (+5% change from 2023).
